summary: Comprehensive re-audit of the personal website after all redesign changes. Evaluates the site from three perspectives: casual internet user, HR head screening candidates, and CEO doing a quick check. Scores architecture, design, content, SEO, and overall impression. Compares against world-class portfolio benchmarks (Brittany Chiang, Lee Robinson, Paco Coursey). Identifies remaining gaps and specific next steps prioritized by impact.
